entities.name: Augusta Tullus
entities.description: A human cleric and dean of Lorehold College who was killed in the New Phyrexian Invasion and returned as an animated spirit statue.

entities.name: Lorehold College
entities.description: College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios where Augusta teaches.

entities.name: Dean Plargg
entities.description: Dean whose dangerous field trips Augusta disapproves of.

entities.name: Murgaxor's orb
entities.description: A dangerous glass relic that let Murgaxor control Augusta's mind.

entities.name: Murgaxor Grenshel
entities.description: A long-banished mage who controlled Augusta through the orb.

entities.name: Deans' Repository
entities.description: Extradimensional archive reached through a hidden portal in the Deans' Wing.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Augusta was killed defending her school.

events.summary: Augusta falls under Murgaxor Grenshel's control through his orb and withdraws into the Deans' Repository, spreading its curse by touch.
events.quote: the orb served as a conduit for the long-banished mage Murgaxor Grenshel

events.summary: Augusta is incapacitated and freed when the orb is destroyed, and works quietly to contain the matter.
events.quote: freeing her from Murgaxor's control when the orb was destroyed

events.summary: Augusta is killed defending her school in the New Phyrexian Invasion and returns as an animated spirit statue.
events.quote: Augusta was killed while defending her school in the New Phyrexian Invasion .

relations.quote: Dean Augusta Tullus was a human cleric teacher at the Lorehold College of Strixhaven University

relations.note: controlled her mind through the orb
relations.quote: who used it to exert control over Tullus's mind and actions
